title: Instagram Video Downloader
summary: Download Instagram photos, videos, Stories, and Saved posts with ease.
description:
Download photos and videos from Instagram posts, Stories, and your Saved collection with IgSaver.

Whether you want to save a photo, a video, a Story, or media from a post you previously saved on Instagram, IgSaver makes it simple to find and download the content to your device.

DOWNLOAD FROM POST LINKS

Copy the link to an Instagram post, paste it into IgSaver, and tap “Discover.” IgSaver will find the available photos and videos so you can preview and select the items you want to download.

DOWNLOAD STORIES

Log in to view currently available Stories from the accounts you follow. Choose a Story, preview its available photos or videos, and download the media you want.

ACCESS YOUR SAVED POSTS

Open your Instagram Saved collection directly in IgSaver. Browse your saved posts, select a post, and download its available photos or videos without copying each link manually.

KEY FEATURES

• Download photos from Instagram posts
• Download videos from Instagram posts
• Browse and download available Stories
• Browse media from your Instagram Saved collection
• Support for posts containing multiple photos and videos
• Preview media before downloading
• Select individual media files to save
• Track active download progress
• Open, share, or delete downloaded files
• View your successfully processed link history
• Simple and easy-to-use interface

HOW TO DOWNLOAD A POST

1. Open Instagram and copy the post link.
2. Open IgSaver and tap “Paste.”
3. Tap “Discover” to find the available media.
4. Select the photos or videos you want.
5. Tap the download button.

HOW TO DOWNLOAD STORIES OR SAVED POSTS

1. Log in to your Instagram account through IgSaver.
2. Open the Stories page or your Saved collection.
3. Select the Story or saved post you want.
4. Choose the available photos or videos.
5. Tap the download button.

ACCOUNT ACCESS

An Instagram login is required to access Stories, private content, and your Saved collection. Login availability and accessible content depend on your Instagram account and the content currently available to you.

IMPORTANT NOTICE

IgSaver is an independent application and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Instagram or Meta.

Please respect the rights of content creators. Only download content that you own or have permission to save and use. You are responsible for ensuring that your use of downloaded content complies with applicable laws and the terms of the relevant platform.
